description:
The Free Travelling Facility scheme is an initiative launched by the Government of India specifically for the benefit of workers in the unorganized sector. 

This scheme is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB). 

The scheme was launched to provide free travel facilities to construction workers and their families. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to ensure that workers can travel without incurring any costs. 

This initiative aims to promote the mobility of construction workers who often face financial constraints. 

The Free Travelling Facility is designed to alleviate the burden of travel expenses on these workers. 

The scheme specifically targets registered construction workers under the HBOCWWB. 

As of October 2023, the scheme is available to all registered construction workers in Haryana. 

To be eligible for this scheme, workers must be registered with the HBOCWWB. 

The age limit for eligibility is typically set at 18 years and above. 

Workers must also be engaged in construction work to qualify for the benefits of this scheme. 

The application process for the Free Travelling Facility is straightforward. 

Workers must first ensure that they are registered with the HBOCWWB. 

They can apply for registration by submitting an application form along with required documents. 

The required documents include proof of identity such as an Aadhar card or voter ID. 

Additionally, proof of employment in the construction sector is necessary. 

Once registered, workers can apply for the Free Travelling Facility. 

The application for the travel facility can be submitted online through the official HBOCWWB website. 

Workers may also visit local offices of the HBOCWWB for assistance. 

Upon successful application, workers will receive a travel pass. 

This pass allows them to travel for free on designated routes. 

The scheme covers various modes of transport including buses and trains. 

The specific routes and schedules are determined by the Haryana government. 

The Free Travelling Facility is particularly beneficial during peak construction seasons. 

The scheme aims to support workers during festivals and other significant events. 

The disbursement of travel passes is typically processed within 15 days of application. 

Workers can avail of this facility multiple times during the year. 

The scheme is part of a broader effort to improve the welfare of construction workers in Haryana. 

The HBOCWWB also provides other benefits such as financial assistance for medical emergencies. 

The Free Travelling Facility is one of the key initiatives aimed at enhancing the quality of life for these workers. 

The scheme was officially launched on 1st January 2022. 

Since its inception, the scheme has seen a significant uptake among registered workers. 

The HBOCWWB has reported that over 50,000 workers have benefited from this facility within the first year. 

This represents a substantial increase in mobility for construction workers. 

The Free Travelling Facility is part of the Haryana government's commitment to worker welfare. 

The scheme is funded by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Fund. 

This fund is generated through contributions from employers in the construction sector. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 10 crores for the initial phase of the scheme. 

The scheme is monitored by the Haryana Labour Department. 

Regular audits are conducted to ensure transparency and effectiveness. 

Workers can also provide feedback on their experiences with the travel facility. 

This feedback is used to improve the scheme and address any issues. 

The Free Travelling Facility is a significant step towards recognizing the contributions of construction workers. 

It aims to empower workers by reducing their travel-related financial burdens. 

The scheme also promotes social inclusion by facilitating easier access to various regions. 

The HBOCWWB is committed to expanding the reach of this facility in the coming years. 

Plans are underway to include more transport routes based on worker demand. 

The government is also exploring partnerships with private transport providers. 

This will enhance the availability of free travel options for construction workers. 

The Free Travelling Facility is a testament to the government's focus on the welfare of the unorganized sector. 

It reflects a growing recognition of the need for support systems for vulnerable workers. 

The scheme is expected to evolve based on the changing needs of the workforce. 

Future enhancements may include digital travel passes for easier access. 

The HBOCWWB is also considering collaborations with other state governments. 

This could lead to a more comprehensive travel assistance program for workers across India. 

The Free Travelling Facility is an essential component of Haryana's labor welfare strategy. 

It aims to create a more supportive environment for construction workers and their families. 

The scheme's success will be measured by the increased mobility and improved quality of life for beneficiaries. 

The government remains committed to ensuring that the benefits reach the intended recipients effectively. 

Overall, the Free Travelling Facility is a crucial initiative that addresses a significant need among construction workers in Haryana. 

It exemplifies the government's dedication to enhancing the welfare of its labor force. 

The scheme is expected to continue making a positive impact in the years to come.
